page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7t.6xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 24 dedicated vCPUs mapped from 12 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at a base clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The system architecture is x86_64, supported by 192 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8 GB per vCPU. Local storage is not bundled with this instance, meaning storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is provisioned with a baseline bandwidth of 12 Gbps.

Benchmark results place the ecs.r7t.6xlarge in the average performance tier across most compute and memory workloads. The instance achieved a single-core Geekbench score of 1586.0 and a multi-core score of 11631.0, alongside a Passmark CPU score of 29448.33. Memory bandwidth tests show read-only small block cached speeds of 1286.38 GB/sec and uncached large block read speeds of 131.14 GB/sec. For specialized tasks, the instance exhibits strong performance in text generation for small language models at 302.83 tokens/sec, while medium model text generation runs at an average rate of 15.35 tokens/sec.

Given its high memory density of 192 GB RAM paired with 24 dedicated vCPUs, the ecs.r7t.6xlarge is qualitatively cost-efficient for memory-bound workloads that do not require local NVMe storage. The absence of local disks represents a tradeoff, shifting storage performance dependencies to network-attached volumes. This profile is well-suited for database operations, in-memory caching systems like Redis, software compilation, and medium-scale enterprise applications requiring substantial memory overhead without dedicated GPU acceleration.
